title: Workforce Agent Overrides
changes: Added company-scoped role and worker override projection using canonical role_definition_id and worker_id identities.
Established deterministic precedence: company defaults, then role override, then worker override.
Made agent overrides contractive only for acknowledgement deadlines, evidence, coordination, staffing, mission-team safeguards and role risk ceilings.
Preserved canonical Workforce graph/catalogue ownership and required runtime authority/risk re-evaluation.
Rejected legacy tenant aliases, cross-company resolution and unknown workers.
